jobs.title: Software-Entwickler:in - Fokus Trainings (M/W/D)*
jobs.description:
Du willst reisen und die leistungsfähigsten Logistikanlagen in Europa mit innovativen Softwarelösungen zum Leben erwecken und hast gleichzeitig Freude daran, junge Kolleg:innen in unseren Softwarestack einzuführen? Dann bist du bei uns richtig!

Als Teil eines internationalen Projektteams führst du die Inbetriebnahmen von vollautomatisierten Logistiksystemen bei unseren Kunden im In- und Ausland durch. Im Zuge unseres internen Trainingsprogramms vermittelst du den Umgang mit unserer proprietären Software an neue Mitarbeiter:innen.

Was man bei uns bewegt:

Customizing der TGW WERX Softwarelösung auf Basis der Detailspezifikation
Programmierung der in den Projekten benötigten Individualsoftware
Durchführung von Software-, System- und Integrationstests
Inbetriebnahme des Systems vor Ort (Hardware und Software) sowie Schulung der Systembetreuer:innen
Erstellung von Dokumentationen sowie Betreuung der Kund:innen in der Hochlaufphase
Durchführung und Weiterentwicklung unseres internen Trainingsprogramms für neue Mitarbeiter:innen

Was uns überzeugt:

Abgeschlossene IT-Ausbildung (z. B. HTL) sowie mindestens 2-jährige Berufserfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung
Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung, vorzugsweise mit objektorientierten Programmiersprachen (Java, .NET) und SQL
Erfahrung als Trainer:in sowie didaktische Fähigkeiten und Freude an Wissensvermittlung
Reisebereitschaft, je nach Projektphase bis zu 75 %
Mobilität (Führerschein B)
Selbstständige:r, flexible:r, stressresistente:r sowie kundenorientierte:r Techniker:in

Was wir bieten:

Flexible Arbeitszeiten und ein großzügiges Home-Office-Modell
Arbeiten mit moderner IT-Ausstattung und neuesten Technologien
Strukturiertes Einarbeitungskonzept und Unterstützung durch erfahrene Kolleg:innen
Internationale Reisetätigkeit und Kennenlernen neuer Länder und Kulturen
Übernahme von Verantwortung in einem erfolgreichen internationalen Unternehmen mit starkem Fokus auf Kultur und Werte

Ready to start?
Wir freuen uns auf dich - ein Einstieg ist ab sofort möglich.

Wir bieten ein attraktives und marktkonformes Gehalt, abhängig von Qualifikation und Berufserfahrung. Das kollektivvertragliche Mindestgrundgehalt Brutto auf Basis einer Vollzeitbeschäftigung beträgt pro Jahr 48.546 Euro

jobs.title: Software Developer – Focus on Trainings (M/F/D)*
jobs.description:
Do you want to travel and bring Europe’s most efficient logistics facilities to life with innovative software solutions, whilst also enjoying introducing young colleagues to our software stack? Then you’ve come to the right place!

As part of an international project team, you’ll carry out the commissioning of fully automated logistics systems for our customers both at home and abroad. As part of our in-house training programme, you’ll teach new staff how to use our proprietary software.

What you'll be handling:

Customising the TGW WERX software solution based on the detailed specification
Programming the bespoke software required for the projects
Carrying out software, system and integration tests
On-site commissioning of the system (hardware and software) and training of system administrators
Preparing documentation and supporting customers during the ramp-up phase
Delivering and further developing our in-house training programme for new employees

What you'll need:

Completed IT training (e.g. HTL) and at least 2 years’ professional experience in software development
Experience in software development, preferably with object-oriented programming languages (Java, .NET) and SQL
Experience as a trainer, along with teaching skills and a passion for sharing knowledge
Willingness to travel, up to 75% depending on the project phase
Mobility (Category B driving licence)
An independent, flexible, stress-resistant and customer-focused technician

What you'll receive:

Flexible working hours and a generous home office model
Working with high-quality IT equipment and the latest technologies
A well-structured training period and support by experienced colleagues
International travel and getting to know new countries and cultures
Responsibility in a successful international company with a strong focus on culture and values

Ready to start?
We're looking forward to meeting you. An immediate start is possible.

We offer an attractive salary in line with the market, which can be above the collective agreement depending on qualifications and experience. The minimum gross basic salary based on full-time employment per year is 48.546 Euro
.

*TGW is an employer that promotes equal opportunities. We invite everybody interested in this job to apply.

jobs.description:

Dabei glauben wir vor allem an eines: Fortschritt in allen Farben.

Aber wir bei BEKO reden nicht nur von der Zukunft. Wir arbeiten daran. Vielleicht schon bald mit dir?

Aufgaben

Entwicklung moderner Web- und Softwareanwendungen
Umsetzung von Frontend- und Backend-Lösungen

jobs.title: Full Stack Software Developer (.NET & Angular)
jobs.description:
Location:
Seville, Spain (Hybrid / Flexible Remote Policy)

Product Area:
PowerLogic Engineering Suite (PLES) / PowerLogic T500 Integration

Position Type:
Full-time

Job Description

We are looking for a Full Stack Software Developer
with experience in both backend and frontend development to join our PowerLogic T500 engineering team in Seville.

The ideal candidate will contribute across the entire software stack, working on desktop and web technologies used to configure, commission, and maintain Schneider Electric's PowerLogic T500 platform within PowerLogic Engineering Suite (PLES)
. We are looking for engineers who enjoy working across different technical areas and can contribute to all development activities within a cross-functional Agile squad.

Responsibilities

Develop new features, enhancements, and bug fixes for the PowerLogic T500 engineering and configuration tools.
Contribute to both frontend and backend development using Angular, TypeScript, C#, and .NET technologies.
Develop and maintain desktop and web-based applications integrated through Electron.
Implement business logic, APIs, data persistence, and user interface components.
Support real-time communications and device interactions using technologies such as SignalR and WebSockets.
Participate in architecture discussions, technical design, code reviews, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Collaborate with Product Owners and squad members in requirements analysis and feature definition.
Ensure software quality through automated testing, cybersecurity, and secure development practices.

Requirements

3+ years of software development experience.
Experience developing applications with C#, .NET, Angular, and TypeScript.
Knowledge of relational databases and ORM frameworks such as PostgreSQL and Entity Framework Core.
Understanding of modern software engineering practices including Object-Oriented Design, Dependency Injection, and automated testing.
Familiarity with real-time communication technologies such as SignalR or WebSockets.
Experience working with Git, Agile/Scrum methodologies, and CI/CD pipelines.
Ability to work effectively in an international and multi-site environment.
Good level of English, both written and spoken.

Desirable Skills

Experience developing desktop applications using Electron.
Knowledge of industrial communication protocols or device integration.
Experience with cloud, DevOps, containerization, or modern deployment practices.
Strong collaboration, problem-solving, and communication skills.
Interest in building software solutions for power systems, digital substations, and critical infrastructure.

What We Offer

Flexible hybrid work model based in Seville.
Opportunity to work with modern technologies including .NET 8, Angular, PostgreSQL, Electron, and SignalR.
International collaboration within a global technology leader.
Continuous learning, career development, and technical growth opportunities.
The possibility to contribute to innovative solutions supporting the digitalization and sustainability of electrical networks

What's in it for me?

Supportive team environment with mentorship to help you grow your technical expertise
Hands-on experience with cutting-edge tools and modern software development practices
Opportunities to contribute to meaningful projects that impact business outcomes
Clear career progression within a technical track designed for long-term growth

Start building your software engineering career with a team that's excited to support your journey!
